newsitem.title: CANADA: MacMillan Bloedel shrs fall after block.
newsitem.headline: MacMillan Bloedel shrs fall after block.

text.p: Shares in MacMillan Bloedel Ltd eased on Monday after Gordon Capital Corp crossed a seven-million share block of the stock in mid-afternoon.
"We don't have any announcements or anything in particular today," said MacMillion Bloedel spokeswoman Marcia Butler.
"It just seems to be some normal course of business buying and selling although it is quite a large block," she added.
Shares in the Vancouver-based forest products firm fell 0.25 to 19.05 on the Toronto Stock Exchange after trading as low as 19 earlier. Turnover totaled 7.27 million shares.
One trader said the block trade was a cash transaction, which meant that settlement of the stock was same-day rather than after three days.
On Nasdaq, the stock was off 19/32 at 13-7/8 in very light volume.
MacMillan Bloedel lost C$0.60 a share in the fourth quarter versus a prior-year profit of C$0.50. The fourth- quarter loss included C$66 million in restructuring costs and asset writedowns.
